sources.description: Professor's exercise requirements; 24 JRL plus 12 CRL Phase 1 scope.
Static page last updated 21 October 2026; bus stops/train station September 2026; names mapping January 2025.
Direct LTA DataMall terms recorded; generic site terms describe personal/non-commercial use and copyright restrictions. These raw files are retained locally for coursework review.
URA MP2019 no-sea subzones, September 2021 vintage, last portal update 3 December 2025.
Singapore Open Data Licence governing the portal dataset.
Updated 17 March 2026; current 25 includes later JS2A; original 24 and three existing-network interchanges.
4 March 2026: JRL1 revised to mid-2028; JS2A mid-2030s; CRL1 2030.
Official 2025 JRL newsletter, original 24 working station names/codes; timeline superseded by 2026 update.
18 January 2023 official CRL1 alignment: CR2-CR13, 12 stations, four existing-network interchanges.
Updated 3 September 2026; Keppel/Cantonment/Prince Edward Road opened 12 July 2026.
Updated 7 July 2026; TEL4 seven opened stations 23 June 2024; TE10/TE21/TE22A deferred; TEL5 scheduled 2026 but actual opening unverified in bounded check.
Official timetable from 13 January 2019: Ten Mile Junction Service C permanently closed.
Pinned commit metadata; main was resolved through public GitHub API after connector file inspection.
Official operator timetable confirms permanent Service C closure from 13 January 2019; fallback after direct LTA PDF acquisition returned 404.

limitations: Historical public-input acquisition stage only: monthly train OD and station-volume archives had not yet been acquired by this public downloader, which uses no LTA AccountKey. Passenger acquisition and final monthly reconciliation are separate; see data/README.md and output/tables/ridership-audit.csv for the completed analysis status.
Direct public fetch with Python's default user agent initially returned 403; ordinary Mozilla/5.0 user agent succeeded. No authentication bypass or session/account access used.
data.gov.sg public poll-download endpoint returns an expiring public S3 URL; only stable API/landing URLs and downloaded content hash are retained.

SingStat current page catalogue was discoverable in search, but body fetch was unreadable/challenge content; population data and notes are user-provided originals, not independently downloaded from the current catalogue.
LTA mapping archive is January 2025 XLS, not a current station roster. CSV conversion is a reproducible convenience derivative.
Official 2026 JRL page expands to 25 stations; assignment's 24 original stations exclude JS2A. Predictions remain JRL24 + CRL1_12.
TE30/TE31/DT36/DT37 actual opening by September 2026 could not be established in bounded official-source check; target-year language is not proof of operation.
